violation_type.title: Space Requirements - Under 18 Months of Age Activity Area (26 TAC §746.4205(a))
violation_type.short_title: Space Requirements - Under 18 Months of Age Activity Area
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation's infant capacity is 4 and 6 infants were present at the time of inspection.

finding_variants.text: The operation's infant capacity is 4 and 6 infants were present at the time of inspection.

The number of infants in care exceeded the infant room's activity space. There were a total of 6 infants in care with two caregivers during the inspection. Based on the space measurements for that infant room the maximum number of children is 5.
The operation space allows for 30 infants and at the time of the inspection there were 32.

The operation has a capacity of 14 infants. The operation had 23 infants present during the inspection. The limit of infants per classroom's space measurements was exceeded.    NOTE: Children were picked up by their parents during the inspection. A request to increase infant capacity was submitted by Director of operation.
Fifty children were combined in the schooll-age classroom. School-Age classroom is licensed for twenty one children.
It was found during the inspection the operation had 24 infants in care and their permit only allows for 18. This was corrected at the inspection when I measured an additional infant room.
